Samir - really appreciate the export, that helps a lot. Summary & proposed next steps below after a quick pass on the numbers you sent.

Quick sizing notes (ballpark):
- Monthly tokens: ~30M total (generation heavy)
- Expected steady-state Q1 post-launch: 40-60M/mo if usage grows as forecasted

Pricing/discount options to consider:
1) Startup program: one-time 30% credit on usage for first 6 months (or $25k credit, whichever is higher) + access to dedicated onboarding resources. Requires eligibility (YC/accelerator or seed stage verification).
2) Committed-use (1-year): tiered discounts on list unit price (applies to total token consumption):
   - Commit $50k/mo => ~10% discount
   - Commit $125k/mo => ~18% discount
   - Commit $250k/mo => ~25% discount
3) Multi-year (2-3 year): additional 5-10% incentive on top of committed discount for 2+ year deals (front-loaded credits or lower unit price).

On unit economics (example for discussion): list price ~ $1,250 / 1M gen tokens (this is list; exact depends on model mix and embedding units). With a 20% committed discount you land around ~$1,000 / 1M gen tokens. With additional startup credits the effective spend in year one looks better.

Next steps:
- If you can confirm a target committed spend band (e.g., $50k/mo vs $125k/mo), I can pull exact pricing math and prepare a draft SOW and term sheet.
- If you're eligible for the startup program, we can layer that on for year one.
- I can also loop in LegalOps for T&Cs if you want to move toward signatures.

Would you be available later this week for a 30-min call to align on commitment level and SLAs?

Best,
